items.title: Hospital Chains Stocks Q2 Highlights: Universal Health Services (NYSE:UHS)
items.summary: The end of the earnings season is always a good time to take a step back and see who shined (and who didn’t). Let’s take a look at how hospital chains stocks fared in Q2, starting with Universal Health Services (NYSE:UHS).

items.title: UHS Adds Talkspace to Accelerate Virtual Behavioral Health Growth
items.summary: Universal Health's $835M Talkspace acquisition expands virtual behavioral health, adding 6,000 providers and new growth opportunities.

items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock with Competitive Advantages and 2 Facing Challenges
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: Can Tenet Healthcare's Hospital Growth Keep Earnings Momentum Going?
items.summary: THC's hospital growth is fueling earnings momentum as stronger volumes, revenues and margins help offset exchange weakness.

items.title: ‘A game changer’: UHS closes $835M Talkspace acquisition
items.summary: Bringing Talkspace on board should expand behavioral health services for UHS’ existing patients, while ushering more consumers through the health system’s doors, UHS CEO Marc Miller said.

items.title: 3 Reasons to Sell UHS and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Shareholders of Universal Health Services would probably like to forget the past six months even happened. The stock dropped 20.7% and now trades at $168.95. This may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: Will Lower PDS Margin Affect Aveanna Healthcare's Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: AVAH's Q2 revenues are expected to rise 9.8%, but lower PDS margins and higher costs may weigh on earnings.

items.title: Can Higher Occupancy Help Brookdale Senior Narrow Q2 Losses?
items.summary: BKD's rising occupancy and pricing actions may support narrower Q2 losses, but will they be enough after four straight earnings misses?
